title: Trace swap under a symmetric weight: tr(P∘S*∘A) = tr(P∘A*∘S)
statement: For all n, N ∈ ℕ, all A, S ∈ L(ℝⁿ, ℝᴺ) (ℝᵈ := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) = Rn d) and every P ∈ L(ℝⁿ) that is symmetric, i.e. ⟨P v, w⟩ = ⟨v, P w⟩ for all v, w ∈ ℝⁿ: trace(P ∘ S* ∘ A) = trace(P ∘ A* ∘ S), where L* := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint L and trace is LinearMap.trace ℝ ℝⁿ applied to the underlying linear map.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (A S : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N) (P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n), (∀ v w : Rn n, inner ℝ (P v) w = inner ℝ v (P w)) → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (P ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint S ∘L A).toLinearMap = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (P ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L S).toLinearMap
